name: Xia Xueyuan
source:
Raina is an ordinary second-year student studying Chemistry in the university. She dated Joe for almost a year but the couple broke up in the summer. They bumped into each other on the 15th of September. Their relationship did not improve but bad luck started to trouble the two.

Her interest is reading fashion magazines.
translation:
Raina is an ordinary second-year student studying Chemistry in the university. She dated Joe for almost a year but the couple broke up in the summer. They bumped into each other on the 15th of September. Their relationship did not improve but bad luck started to trouble the two.

Her interest is reading fashion magazines.
